description: Test file for Elasticsearch-related functions in Mattermost, including index name building and post conversion for indexing, with extensive tests for message attachments and API JSON unmarshalling.

methods.name: TestElasticsearchBuildPostIndexName
methods.description: Tests the function for building Elasticsearch index names based on date and aggregation cutoff.

methods.name: TestESPostFromPostForIndexing
methods.description: Tests conversion of PostForIndexing to Elasticsearch post format with various message and attachment scenarios.

methods.name: TestESPostFromPost_CreatePostJSONRoundTrip
methods.description: Simulates the full flow of creating a post, marshaling/unmarshaling attachments, and converting to Elasticsearch format.

methods.name: TestESPostFromPost_APIJSONUnmarshal
methods.description: Tests handling of posts created via API with attachments arriving as []any.

methods.name: TestGetMatchesForHit
methods.description: Tests extraction of matched snippets from search hit highlights.
